name: agent-of-record-skills
description: The agent-of-record skill set: bridge operation, memory, self-improvement and authoring skills for Claude Cowork on macOS and Windows.
_comment_skills: Source of truth for what ships. Each entry names a directory under CoworkConfig/Skills/. 'platforms' is enforced by scripts/build_plugin.py --strict: a skill listed for macos that still contains Windows-only text fails the build. The eight bridge, memory and bookend skills are declared for windows only until their text is made platform-correct, one skill per commit; the macOS bundle carries the two that already are.
